title: Last Week in Swamp: week of Oct 19 – Oct 25, 2026
disclaimer: Generated automatically from public swamp registry data. Summaries are machine-written descriptions of each change, not reviews, and can be wrong; the registry and the extension's source are authoritative. Authors can leave the digest by adding the `no-digest` label to their extension.

items.name: @bixu/cull
items.summary: A new extension, @bixu/cull, was released at version 2026.10.22.1 with a single method, cull. It takes a Canon R5 II card or an ingest folder, scores the images by sharpness and in-camera rating, and copies the keepers.

items.name: @bixu/invariant-encoding-check
items.summary: A new extension, @bixu/invariant-encoding-check, makes CI fail when a changed swamp extension model file leaves a known invariant unencoded in its zod schema. It also ships shared zod schemas for Sha256Digest, Platform, and SshFingerprint, and adds one method, check.

items.name: @bmonty/text-entropy
items.summary: The @bmonty/text-entropy extension was first released as version 2026.10.22.1 and adds a single method, analyze, which measures the Shannon entropy of a piece of text. The release is an initial addition with no earlier versions to compare against.

items.name: @cachehit/techdocs
items.summary: The first release of @cachehit/techdocs, version 2026.10.23.1, adds four methods: search, get_doc, build_context, and sync. It searches and builds AI context from a Hugo documentation site's source repository, whether that repository is hosted in GitLab or checked out locally, and supports Docsy or other themes.

items.name: @figy/blog
items.summary: @figy/blog is a first release, version 2026.10.24.2, that renders Markdown posts from an Obsidian vault folder and publishes them to Cloudflare Pages. It followed version 2026.10.24.1 within the same window.

items.name: @hmcrum/nfl-player-stats
items.summary: A new extension, @hmcrum/nfl-player-stats, makes its first release (2026.10.22.1) and adds two methods: box_score and week_stats. It provides real NFL player box-score statistics from ESPN's public summary endpoint, which requires no authentication.

items.name: @keeb/exa
items.summary: Initial release of @keeb/exa (version 2026.10.24.1), adding two methods: search, which runs any Exa web search, and find_people, which looks up people's LinkedIn profiles in bulk by running one people-category search per person and scoring each candidate against employer, email domain, location, and GitHub handle.

items.name: @keeb/scenerules
items.summary: Swamp registry extension @keeb/scenerules is a first release (version 2026.10.25.1) that replicates the scenerules.org ruleset as a swamp model.

items.name: @magistr/mitmproxy
items.summary: The @magistr/mitmproxy extension is new, adding methods to install, start, stop, and inspect a local mitmproxy HTTP/HTTPS intercepting proxy from swamp, plus trust the proxy's CA certificate and clear captured flows.

items.name: @magistr/openssl
items.summary: This new extension provides eight methods for inspecting, creating, signing, verifying and converting X.509 certificates through the local openssl CLI: inspect, csr, genkey, selfsign, sign, verify, convert and version.

items.name: @puddleworks/puddleworks-factory
items.summary: Puddleworks Factory is a first release that adds a draft.run method. It prefills an app spec from an agreed outcome spec, then builds a first draft of a swamp app from an app spec read from a file, URL, or inline JSON.

items.name: @reset/buildq
items.summary: The @reset/buildq extension is a first release, published as version 2026.10.24.1, that drives a buildq coordinator over its HTTP API in a Buildkite-style shape.

items.name: @reset/cheapshark-deals
items.summary: The first release of @reset/cheapshark-deals, version 2026.10.24.1, records PC game prices across CheapShark's stores and flags price drops. It adds three methods: sample, search, and summarise.

items.name: @reset/crates-downloads
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/crates-downloads, records download counts and version history for crates.io crates over time. Its first release (2026.10.24.1) adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/discord-webhook
items.summary: The @reset/discord-webhook extension is a first release, now at version 2026.10.22.2 after an earlier 2026.10.22.1 release in the same window. It adds a single send method that posts a message with embeds to a Discord webhook from a workflow.

items.name: @reset/dockerhub-pulls
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/dockerhub-pulls, was released at version 2026.10.24.1. It records pull counts, star counts and tags for Docker Hub images over time, and adds two methods: sample, which captures those figures, and summarise, which reports on them.

items.name: @reset/epic
items.summary: The @reset/epic extension is a first release, version 2026.10.22.2, that samples Epic Games Store prices and discounts and records free games. It adds three methods: freeGames, sample, and summarise.

items.name: @reset/fmod
items.summary: The @reset/fmod extension is a first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that drives FMOD Studio's command line tool from Swamp.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-commits
items.summary: This new extension, @reset/forgejo-commits, records the commits and head of a Forgejo or Gitea branch over time. Its first release, version 2026.10.24.1, adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-issues
items.summary: New extension @reset/forgejo-issues records Forgejo or Gitea issues and tracks how many remain open over time. Its first release, 2026.10.24.1, adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-pulls
items.summary: Forgejo and Gitea pull request driver, first released as 2026.10.21.1 and updated to 2026.10.24.1. It adds seven methods for listing and reading pull requests, reading commit statuses by context, listing and posting comments, and asking the repository's merge bot to merge or rush a pull request.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-releases
items.summary: This is a new extension, the first release at version 2026.10.22.1, that records Forgejo or Gitea releases and their asset downloads. It adds two methods, one to sample releases and one to summarise them.

items.name: @reset/forgejo-repo-stats
items.summary: Initial release of @reset/forgejo-repo-stats (version 2026.10.24.1), which records Forgejo or Gitea repository stars and counters over time. It adds two methods: sample, and summarise.

items.name: @reset/github-releases
items.summary: This is the first release of @reset/github-releases, version 2026.10.22.1. It records GitHub releases and asset downloads and summarises them, adding two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/godot

items.name: @reset/godot-assets
items.summary: Adds the first release of @reset/godot-assets (version 2026.10.23.1), which records Godot Asset Library assets' versions and ratings over time. It adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/gog
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/gog, was released in its first version, 2026.10.22.1, and updated to 2026.10.22.2. It samples a GOG product's store data and summarises its price history, adding two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/hackernews-mentions
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/hackernews-mentions, makes its first release (version 2026.10.24.1) to record Hacker News mentions of a game, studio or product. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/homebrew-installs
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/homebrew-installs, records Homebrew formula and cask installs and their versions over time. Its first release, 2026.10.24.1, adds two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/itch
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/itch, is published at version 2026.10.22.2 and records itch.io games and their channel versions, including what changed between them. It adds three methods: credentials, games, and latest, and this is its first release in the window, following version 2026.10.22.1.

items.name: @reset/lemmy-mentions
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/lemmy-mentions, has its first release, 2026.10.24.1. It records Lemmy mentions of a game, studio or product, and adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/mastodon-hashtags
items.summary: Records how a Mastodon instance's hashtag usage and posts change over time, with a new first release (2026.10.24.1) that adds a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/modio
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/modio, has been released at version 2026.10.23.1. It records a game's mods and their mod.io statistics, and summarises their growth, through two new methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/npm-downloads
items.summary: This new extension, @reset/npm-downloads, records npm packages' daily download counts and latest versions over time. It adds two methods: a sample method that collects the data and a summarise method that reports on it.

items.name: @reset/nuget-downloads
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/nuget-downloads, was released as version 2026.10.24.1. It records NuGet package download counts and latest versions over time, and adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/patch-notes
items.summary: This is the first release of @reset/patch-notes, version 2026.10.22.1. It announces a Steam game's new patch notes in Discord, posting one embed for each.

items.name: @reset/protondb
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/protondb, was released in its first version, 2026.10.23.1. It samples a Steam game's ProtonDB tier and score and summarises them, through two new methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/pypi-downloads
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/pypi-downloads, has been released at version 2026.10.24.1. It records daily download counts and latest versions for PyPI projects, with sample and summarise methods.

items.name: @reset/rollbar
items.summary: Rollbar-compatible crash-reporting client (first release, version 2026.10.24.1) that lists and reads items, occurrences and events, and can resolve, mute, assign, and record deploys. It also adds occurrence, activation and top-item reports, and logs item filters readably.

items.name: @reset/sentry-issues
items.summary: This new extension records a Sentry project's top issues and tracks how their counts grow over time. It adds two methods, sample and summarise, for collecting and reviewing that data.

items.name: @reset/socialq
items.summary: New extension that reads a socialq deployment over its HTTP API using a Cloudflare Access service token. It adds eight methods covering health, the token's identity, accounts, the calendar and recorder coverage, the wrap-up report, daily activity, the job ledger, and the taxonomy.

items.name: @reset/speedrun-leaderboards
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/speedrun-leaderboards, was released as its first version, 2026.10.24.1. It records speedrun.com leaderboards over time and tracks record moves, adding two methods: a sample method and a summarise method.

items.name: @reset/steam
items.summary: Uploads a game's builds to Steam and sets them live on a branch. The extension adds four methods: betas, builds, setLive, and upload. This is the first release, version 2026.10.24.1.

items.name: @reset/steam-achievements
items.summary: Adds the new extension @reset/steam-achievements, its first release, with versions 2026.10.22.1 and 2026.10.22.2 in this window. It provides two methods: one samples a Steam app's achievement unlock rates, and the other summarises those rates.

items.name: @reset/steam-news
items.summary: Records a Steam app's news and patch notes and flags new posts. The extension was first released at version 2026.10.22.2, adding two methods: fetch and list.

items.name: @reset/steam-players
items.summary: First release of @reset/steam-players, which samples a Steam app's concurrent player count and summarises its history. It adds two methods, sample and summarise, and ships a README covering app ids, intervals, comparing apps, trends, and stored data.

items.name: @reset/steam-reviews
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/steam-reviews, was added in its first release, published as versions 2026.10.22.1 and 2026.10.22.2. It provides two methods: one samples a Steam app's review score, and the other summarises that score's history.

items.name: @reset/steam-workshop
items.summary: The @reset/steam-workshop extension is a new first release, version 2026.10.22.1, that adds two methods: one to sample a Steam Workshop item's public stats and one to summarise them. Its stated purpose is sampling and summarising public Workshop item statistics.

items.name: @reset/steamspy
items.summary: This is the first release of @reset/steamspy, version 2026.10.23.1. It adds two methods: sample, which pulls an app's SteamSpy estimates, and summarise, which describes how those estimates change over time.

items.name: @reset/steamworks-builds
items.summary: This is a new extension, @reset/steamworks-builds, first released as version 2026.10.23.1. It records a Steam app's branches and builds and how they move between branches, and it adds two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/steamworks-sales
items.summary: New extension @reset/steamworks-sales, first released as version 2026.10.23.1. It records a Steam partner's daily sales aggregates and summarises them, through two methods: sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/steamworks-wishlists
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/steamworks-wishlists, was released as version 2026.10.23.1 to record and summarise a Steam app's daily wishlist activity. It adds two methods, sample and summarise.

items.name: @reset/twitch-viewers
items.summary: A new extension, @reset/twitch-viewers, first released as version 2026.10.23.1, records and summarises a game's live Twitch streams and viewer counts. It adds two methods: sample, which captures the data, and summarise, which reports on it.

items.name: @reset/unity
items.summary: The @reset/unity extension is a first release, version 2026.10.24.1, that drives the Unity Editor in batch mode through its command-line arguments.

items.name: @reset/workq
items.summary: The @reset/workq extension is a first release, now at version 2026.10.24.1, that lets swamp call workq's work-tracking API as a client. It adds eleven methods to read the current user, an org's projects, items with filters, item history, releases and sprints, and to create, change, and comment on items.

items.name: @reset/wwise
items.summary: The new @reset/wwise extension is an initial release (version 2026.10.24.1) that drives an open Wwise Authoring instance over WAAPI and WAMP.

items.name: @skunk-ape/hermes
items.summary: The @skunk-ape/hermes extension is a first release, version 2026.10.25.1, that lets users run Hermes agents on macOS or Linux, each confined to its own directory by a nono sandbox.

items.name: @skunk-ape/web-brief
items.summary: A first release of @skunk-ape/web-brief, version 2026.10.24.1, gives an autonomous agent web access without a browser. It adds two methods, fetch and summarize.

items.name: @sntxrr/docker-ps
items.summary: The @sntxrr/docker-ps extension has its first release, version 2026.10.25.1, adding a host.ps method. It provides read-only listing of containers on a Docker host over SSH, scoped for use by an unattended triage agent.

items.name: @sntxrr/log-tail
items.summary: A new swamp registry extension, @sntxrr/log-tail, was published in its first release at version 2026.10.25.1. It reads the last lines of a log selected by name from an allowlist fixed in the model definition, with secret values redacted, and adds two methods: allowlist.list and allowlist.tail.

items.name: @sntxrr/traefik
items.summary: A first release of @sntxrr/traefik, version 2026.10.25.1, adds three methods (instance.bump, instance.check, instance.inspect) for keeping Traefik reverse proxies, their companion images such as CrowdSec, and their loaded plugins current.

items.name: @sntxrr/uptime-kuma
items.summary: A new extension, @sntxrr/uptime-kuma, makes its first release in this window, at version 2026.10.25.1 (after 2026.10.22.1).

items.name: @svendowideit/cloudflare-pages-wrangler
items.summary: This is a first release of the extension, published as version 2026.10.24.2 after an earlier 2026.10.24.1 in the same window. It adds three methods for deploying to Cloudflare Pages without a Git repository: createProject, deployDirect for direct uploads, and bindDomain for custom domains.

items.name: @svendowideit/markdown2html
items.summary: The @svendowideit/markdown2html extension is a first release, now at version 2026.10.24.2, that renders Markdown files into a static HTML site with an index page and needs neither Python nor special content markers. It adds one method, generate.

items.name: @svendowideit/s3-archive-planner
items.summary: A new extension, @svendowideit/s3-archive-planner (version 2026.10.25.1), plans an Australian photo and video archive on Amazon S3.

items.name: @swamp/cve
items.summary: Adds a new extension that finds and fixes Linux, macOS, and Windows hosts and Linux containers still trusting eight eMudhra intermediate CAs whose private keys were compromised.

items.name: @swamp/gcp/deepreview
items.summary: The new `@swamp/gcp/deepreview` extension is a first release (2026.10.23.1) that adds Google Cloud infrastructure models for managing documents and document reviews. It provides create, get, list, and sync methods for document reviews, plus get, list, sync, and delete methods for documents.

items.name: @taylor/emudhra
items.summary: Adds the @taylor/emudhra extension, first released in this window and now at version 2026.10.22.6, with one method, exposure.scan. Per its description, it checks where private keys from eight compromised eMudhra certificate authorities could still be used.

items.name: @taylor/libvirt
items.summary: The initial release of the libvirt extension sets up an Ubuntu host to run KVM/QEMU virtual machines through libvirt. It adds check and apply methods for host packages and libvirt/kvm group membership, directory storage pools, networks, virtual machines, and an uplink check.

items.name: @vcjdeboer/opentofu
items.summary: This is a first release of @vcjdeboer/opentofu, with versions 2026.10.22.1 through 2026.10.23.2 in the window, and it adds six methods for planning and applying OpenTofu through a sha-bound gate: init, validate, plan, apply, output, and version.

items.name: @vcjdeboer/quarto-deck
items.summary: Initial release of an extension that makes Quarto reveal.js lecture decks render the same way each time and keeps a record of how each one was built. It adds 16 methods for rendering, checking, PDF and PPTX export, PPTX extraction and conversion, slide and source management, figure cropping, and outlining.

items.name: @webframp/anthropic/admin
items.summary: This new extension lets you manage members of a Claude Enterprise organization through the Admin API, including reading members, custom roles, and RBAC groups, adding members to groups, and switching members between User and Custom organization roles.

items.name: @webframp/aws/php2shell-hunt

items.title: October 19th, 2026 — AI Frontiers
items.description: Episode 12 of AI Frontiers with Matthew Dean Furlo. Industry experts run down all the AI news for engineers. Adam Jacob, Paul Stack, and Nick Stinemates…

items.title: Gatekeeping in the Age of AI
items.author: stack72
items.summary: Every shift in software has been told it’s already solved. With AI, that pushback has become gatekeeping, and it risks talking us out of the biggest chance in decades to change how we build.

items.title: Asking swamp first, even for this blog — Notes
items.author: tagur
items.summary: Why I reach for swamp first, how I built this blog with it, and what I still need to work out before using it for network changes.

items.title: How Much of Your Software Factory Can Run in the Dark?
items.author: stack72
items.summary: Our lights-on software factory builds systems we want to operate with the lights off. We work through the responsibility we’re giving those systems, build it into the operation and let them run. When something new comes back, we have more work to do in the software factory.

items.title: Setting up Swamp in a C# and Unity shop · reset.dev
items.author: reset
items.summary: A developer documents the first-day experience configuring Swamp, a TypeScript-based automation CLI, in a C# and Unity game studio, covering installation quirks, behavior and workflow setup, agent scoping with --tool none, and telemetry transparency.

items.title: Telling swamp what I want
items.author: svendowideit
items.summary: A developer builds a custom swamp workflow that converts Obsidian markdown blog posts to HTML and publishes them to Cloudflare Pages with automatic DNS setup via Caddy, without requiring a separate git repository.
